name: A long quiet stretch of work gets a small face, not a finish
judge: After twelve quiet minutes of work, Boop checks in. Nothing new has happened, so this is a small sign of life.
reasonable: A small or medium face, such as calm, engaged, determined, hopeful, bored or lazy, or nothing. A grunt or a word about the work is fine. Mood may drift with the grind.
unreasonable: A finish animation while work goes on, a big celebration or big upset with nothing new, or sadness or anger out of nowhere.
